policy: Reconstructable editable .blend files remain outsideGit to avoid duplicating canonical geometry/textures. Exact hashes are in the committed manifests. Source GLBs, adopted texture kit, scripts, selected PNGs and verification receipts are versioned.
restore: Use the commands in tools/production-art-stage/README.md with these exact source hashes and fresh output directories. New .blend container hashes may differ; source geometry/textures and the saved recipes own reconstruction.
